_comment_file: Two SCIM PATCH operation payloads for Day 07 lab. Replace <PLACEHOLDER> values with real IDs in your environment.

operations._comment: PATCH 1: Offboarding — deactivate user and remove from payment-approvers group

Operations._comment_op: Set active=false. This disables the account without deleting the record. The user cannot log in. Access tokens must be invalidated separately.

Remove the user from the payment-approvers group. Note: this PATCH targets the User resource but the groups attribute on User is read-only in most SCIM implementations. In those cases, send a separate PATCH to the Group resource (see SOLUTION.md). This entry is here for completeness and to illustrate the intent.

operations._comment: PATCH 2: Re-activation — re-hire same user identified by externalId
operations._precondition: Before this call, the SCIM client must have searched: GET /Users?filter=externalId eq '<PLACEHOLDER-external-id>' and confirmed id=<PLACEHOLDER-user-id> with active=false.

Operations._comment_op: Set active=true. Re-enables the account. The historical audit records (previous access events, consent history) remain linked to this user-id.
Update email in case it changed during the gap. Using filter path syntax to target only the work email value.
Update department if the employee is returning to a different cost centre. Uses EnterpriseUser extension path.

operations._comment: PATCH 3: Group resource update — add user back to payment-approvers (send this after PATCH 2)
operations._note: Group membership must be managed on the Group resource, not on the User resource. This is a separate PATCH call.

Operations._comment_op: Add the re-hired user back to the payment-approvers group members list.
